items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like Charter Communications Stock?
items.summary: Charter Communications has considerably underperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are cautious about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Expands Local News Access And Ad Reach Across Key Markets
items.summary: Charter Communications (NasdaqGS:CHTR) and Optimum announced a new agreement to broaden local news access and advertising reach across major U.S. markets. The deal restores and widens distribution of channels such as Spectrum News NY1 and News 12 for TV customers in regions including New York, Texas and North Carolina. items.title: Spectrum rolls out free offer after steep customer losses
items.summary: Spectrum is sweetening its internet plans as it faces mounting pressure to keep customers from leaving.

items.title: What Cox Communication customers in Oklahoma should expect after Spectrum acquisition
items.summary: Charter Communications Inc., the company that owns Spectrum, completed its acquisition of Cox Communications Aug. 20. items.summary: AT&T is outperforming many of its telecom rivals, but its stock price doesn't seem to reflect that success.

items.title: Charter closes $34.5 billion Cox Communications merger
items.summary: The combined company now serves 37 million customers across 45 states, with Spectrum branding set to launch in Cox markets in mid-September

items.title: Charter Closes Its $34.5B Cox Deal. Why the Stock Is Sinking.
items.summary: Charter stock was dropping as it concludes its deal for Cox Communications, amid fears it could just add to its subscriber issues.

items.title: Charter finalizes $34.5-billion Cox takeover, bringing Spectrum to millions more customers
items.summary: With the $34.5-billion purchase, Cox customers in San Diego, Las Vegas and Phoenix will soon get Spectrum service — and the Dodgers channel, ending a long TV drought.
